title: Dual Mesh Pipelines to Fix VUID-08114
description: Implemented dual pipeline system for mesh shader rendering to eliminate VUID-08114 validation errors when shell TLAS is not available

technical_summary.problem: VUID-08114 validation error occurred when mesh shader fragment code referenced binding 4 (shell TLAS) but the descriptor was not updated when shell TLAS was not ready
technical_summary.solution: Created dual pipeline architecture with conditional shader compilation and runtime pipeline selection based on shell TLAS availability
technical_summary.approach: Shader preprocessing with USE_SHELL_TLAS define to create two pipeline variants

particle_mesh.frag.fallback_function: hasSelfShadowRT returns -1.0 when shell TLAS not available

MeshParticleRenderer.cpp.descriptor_layouts: createDescriptorSetLayout() creates both full and external-only layouts
MeshParticleRenderer.cpp.shader_loading: loadShaders() loads both fragment shader variants
MeshParticleRenderer.cpp.render_function: render() uses pipeline selection based on shell TLAS readiness

before.vuid_08114: PRESENT - Descriptor binding 4 statically used but never updated
before.application_status: Functional but validation errors in debug mode

after.vuid_08114: ELIMINATED - External-only pipeline avoids binding 4 entirely
after.application_status: Clean validation when shell TLAS not available
console_output: External-only mesh particle pipeline created successfully!

pipeline_selection_logic.fallback: Falls back to original pipeline if external-only unavailable

testing.environment: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti, Windows WSL2
testing.test_scenario: Stellar Formation preset, dual pipeline system active
